macro.title: Ex-OpenAI engineer accused of planting bug in office was in contact with Saudi royal family, preparing to leave U.S. - CBS News
macro.summary: The wife and infant son of the ex-OpenAI engineer left the U.S. for Saudi Arabia in October with business-class tickets purchased by a Saudi military official, prosecutors allege.

macro.title: Nscale, Anthropic in Talks for $45 Billion Cloud Computing Deal - Bloomberg
macro.summary: Nscale Ltd., the AI cloud computing firm, is in talks to sell computing power to Anthropic PBC in a deal that could be worth about $45 billion, according to people familiar with the negotiations.
